name: Akihara Shiho
source:
Shiho as an adult
A more mature woman that meets Senoo at high school reunion. A wiser woman with still some glimpse of personality from high school. Hasn't seen or talk to Senoo since they last departed during high school.

[spoiler] After reuniting is finally able to tell Senoo the truth. The man she had a crush on all those years as a kid/teen was him. At the very end refused to date him for  feeling guilty. She was secretly happy when he broke his arm and not being able to play baseball. Every girl that liked because of baseball went away leaving Shiho being able to monopolize him for herself. [/spoiler]
translation:
Shiho as an adult
A more mature woman that meets Senoo at high school reunion. A wiser woman with still some glimpse of personality from high school. Hasn't seen or talk to Senoo since they last departed during high school.

[spoiler] After reuniting is finally able to tell Senoo the truth. The man she had a crush on all those years as a kid/teen was him. At the very end refused to date him for  feeling guilty. She was secretly happy when he broke his arm and not being able to play baseball. Every girl that liked because of baseball went away leaving Shiho being able to monopolize him for herself. [/spoiler]
